ana: Heads-up: accelerated pricing pilot goes live TOMORROW 09:00 PT. Need final billing preflight for the 10% pilot cohort ('pilot-fast'). Goal is to measure invoice deltas and catch any reconciliation errors. @mike @shilpa please confirm meter mapping & refund/grandfathering window.

mike: On it. I'll run an invoice preview and sanity-check the aggregator. ETA ~2h. Any vendor rate changes we should coordinate?

shilpa: Vendor rate sheet updated last night (v3). @ben_fin please confirm mapping to ratecard_id=rp_accel_v3. Also confirm grandfathering policy — product asked for a 14-day preserve for existing subs, right?

ben_fin: Confirmed mapping -> rp_accel_v3. Grandfathering: product requested a 14-day legacy window. We need a cohort flag so billing flow applies "legacy_rate" for usage billed during that window. I'll open a PR for the billing rule and tag ops.

evan-bot: billing-preview job started for cohort pilot-fast (run_id=31872). ETA ~40m. Logs: https://internal/redwood/jobs/31872

mike: Quick check of preview — results look ok for most sample orgs but one account shows missing meter 'token_gpu_ms' -> fallback to 'token_ms' triggered. Will double-check aggregator joins. SQL I used: ```SELECT account_id, sum(tokens) as toks FROM usage.events WHERE date >= '2026-03-01' GROUP BY account_id;```

shilpa: Thanks — I'll patch ETL mapping so token_gpu_ms maps correctly. Also adding a validation rule: flag accounts where token_gpu_ms > 0 AND token_ms IS NULL.

ana (typo correction not needed):

ana: (ignore)

ana: Finance needs the invoice delta report before 2pm PT today. ben_fin can you produce preflight_delta.csv with columns: account_id, old_total, new_total, delta_usd, error_flag?

ben_fin: Yes, running now. Will post link when ready. We'll flag any delta > $1,000 for manual review.

tara: Legal asked about opt-in/grandfather messaging on the bill. Suggested text: "You have access to a temporary legacy rate for 14 days." Is that ok?

ana: Use that wording. Also need sign-off from ops and product on rollback thresholds. @mike @shilpa please confirm rollback plan if we see surge >20% cost or error rate >1%.

mike: Rollback plan: toggle cohort routing back to rp_stable, abort new rate assignment, and trigger immediate billing-preview rerun. Ops runbook updated: https://playbooks/redwood/pricing-pilot-rollback

shilpa: :thumbsup: I'll watch ETL patch deploy. If ETL patch fails, fallback mapping will preserve old meter mapping so no double-billing.

ben_fin: preflight_delta.csv uploaded: https://files.redwood/preflight/31872/preflight_delta.csv. Summary: avg delta +0.9%, 12 accounts > $1k flagged, no invoice errors in sample.

ana: Awesome. Final checklist: (1) vendor rate sync done ✅ (2) grandfathering logic PR open ✅ (3) preflight report posted ✅ (4) legal message approved ✅. Launch in 30m. Call if anything breaks.

evan-bot: deploybot: pricing-pilot v1 -> canary started at 2134567905 :rocket:
